exercise: Sign in with MFA identify the assigned role and explain which sensitive actions require escalation
expected_outcome: The technician uses secure access and stays within the approved role
evidence_to_capture: MFA success role or permission view and technician explanation
pass_criterion: Access succeeds with MFA and the technician correctly identifies permitted prohibited and escalation-only actions
stop_condition: Missing MFA excess privilege shared credentials or inability to explain role boundaries

exercise: Locate a named endpoint and reconcile its customer site hostname operating system owner and last check-in
expected_outcome: The technician selects the intended endpoint without crossing customer boundaries
evidence_to_capture: Endpoint view or export showing customer site identifiers and current check-in
pass_criterion: All identity fields match the approved test record and no cross-tenant navigation occurs
stop_condition: Wrong tenant wrong endpoint duplicate identity stale check-in or ambiguous placement

exercise: Interpret a controlled alert validate context and timestamps and route it to a named owner
expected_outcome: The technician distinguishes evidence from assumption and assigns an owned next action
evidence_to_capture: Alert record route or ticket receipt and written triage rationale
pass_criterion: Severity context timestamps and route are correct and the next action has an owner
stop_condition: Missing context unjustified suppression misrouting or no accountable owner

exercise: Explain scan state approval policy reboot requirements final outcome and any exception
expected_outcome: The technician reconciles patch evidence instead of treating dispatch as completion
evidence_to_capture: Pre-scan policy job receipt reboot state post-scan and exception record
pass_criterion: The final state is reproducible and every unresolved item has a documented exception or owner
stop_condition: Dispatch-only evidence inconsistent state unauthorized approval or unresolved unknown outcome

exercise: Review scope and prerequisites run one harmless approved action and show the rollback or stop path
expected_outcome: The intended action reaches only the intended endpoint and produces interpretable output
evidence_to_capture: Approval scope command or script hash target output timestamps and rollback evidence
pass_criterion: Target scope actor output and final state match the approved test and rollback is understood
stop_condition: Wrong target excessive privilege unreviewed code missing output or no safe stop path

exercise: Verify authorization connect to the intended endpoint and preserve the required audit trail
expected_outcome: The technician uses remote access only within policy and leaves reproducible evidence
evidence_to_capture: Authorization record session audit entry target identity and session end state
pass_criterion: Authorization target identity actor timing and closure are all verified
stop_condition: No authorization wrong device unattended access outside policy or missing audit evidence

exercise: Move from a device or alert to the correct customer record and document the issue action evidence owner and next checkpoint
expected_outcome: Another technician can continue the work without reconstructing context
evidence_to_capture: Ticket or case link device reference action note evidence link owner and next checkpoint
pass_criterion: The record is correctly scoped concise reproducible and owned
stop_condition: Cross-customer record missing evidence unclear action or no owner and checkpoint

exercise: Produce a dated report or export with explicit filters time range source and limitations
expected_outcome: The report can be reproduced and its scope cannot be mistaken
evidence_to_capture: Saved report or export plus filter and time-range notes
pass_criterion: A reviewer reproduces the same scope and understands all material limitations
stop_condition: Undated output hidden filters mixed tenants unverifiable totals or unsupported conclusions

exercise: Diagnose a missing check-in by proving install service state identity network path tenant placement and fresh telemetry in order
expected_outcome: The technician finds the first broken handoff without random reinstall attempts
evidence_to_capture: Local install and service evidence network test tenant placement and dashboard timestamp
pass_criterion: The root cause is isolated or the escalation packet identifies the first unproven handoff
stop_condition: Repeated reinstall without diagnosis disabled security controls wrong tenant or unsupported root-cause claim

exercise: Identify a wrong-target excessive-privilege unclear-output failed-rollback or cross-tenant scenario and stop safely
expected_outcome: The technician recognizes when not to continue and supplies an actionable escalation
evidence_to_capture: Stop record affected scope evidence collected risk statement and escalation owner
pass_criterion: Work stops before wider impact and the escalation contains enough evidence for a safe decision
stop_condition: Continuing after a stop condition hiding uncertainty or escalating without scope and evidence
